brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the accuracy of SPINESCAN® with standard lateral x-rays of the spine in patients monitored for kyphosis.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients examined in scoliosis clinic for kyphosis with recent lateral spine X-rays.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has anaplastic astrocytoma of the spine and does not appear to have been examined in a scoliosis clinic for kyphosis, nor is there any mention of recent lateral spine X-rays.
There is no information provided regarding the patient's ability or inability to provide informed consent, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient provided informed consent for participation in the trial, as documented in the medical record?
